{{Quote|That was the cannus solix! You would've known that if you hadn't been off starting fights when the judges explained the difference.|Leia Organa Solo pretends to chid her husband for mistaking an Ornuk for a cannus solix|<ref name="Ab" />}}
'''Cannus solix''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of animal kept as pets during the reign of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. At least one cannus solix may have been entered into [[Sok Brok's Fiftieth Annual Pet Show]],<ref name="Ab" /> a pet show held on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] in [[43 ABY]].<ref name="MF">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref> When attempting to distract the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Seff Hellin]] later that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]],<ref name="Ab" /> who had attended the pet show and seen Seff there when he helped save their [[Allana Djo Solo|granddaughter]] from a kidnapping attempt,<ref name="MF" /> pretended to argue about which creature had nearly bitten Han's ankle at the show, with Han believing it was an [[Ornuk]] and Leia stating that it was the cannus solix. Leia claimed Han didn't know the difference between the species as he had missed one of the show's judges explaining it whilst he was away starting a fight.<ref name="Ab" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cannus solix were first mentioned in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Abyss]]'' by [[Troy Denning]]. The species is mentioned during an acted conversation between Han and Leia whilst they try and distract Seff and it is unclear how much of the exchanged is based on real events. The pet show in question appeared in a previous novel, [[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']] by [[James Luceno]] and no mention of the cannus solix was made, with a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard/Legends|Kowakian monkey-lizard]] being the only animal to bite Han's ankle.
